author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] Speech preparation, checked. The page prepares no spoken text of its own: device speech, Read new and the call relay all read the server's spoken_content, falling back to the raw content. The server's preparation (vibe-talk/src/speakable.rs, strip_inline) has the broader form of the same bug: it drops EVERY underscore, inside a word or not, so a SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE identifier is spoken as one run-together word. This change is page-only and the host forbids cargo for it, so the server is unchanged. Follow-up: an underscore between two letters or digits should become a space in spoken text (or stay), and only a flanking underscore should be dropped as an emphasis marker, with a speakable.rs unit test for each shape.
